title: The Double Measurement Confound in Agent Benchmarks: De-Scaffolding, Ground-Truth Scoring, and Reliability Beyond the Mean
abstract: arXiv:2609.09218v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agent benchmarks are increasingly used to compare large language models (LLMs) and guide deployment decisions, yet benchmark scores are meaningful only if they measure model capability rather than properties of the evaluation pipeline. We identify a double measurement confound: execution-critical decisions are performed by a fixed scaffold instead of the model, while the scorer evaluates outputs using criteria that may not reflect task correctness. We unify these issues within a measurement-theoretic framework that characterizes when benchmark scores can be interpreted as evidence of model capability, and instantiate it with an audit-and-repair protocol that (i) transfers execution-critical decisions from the scaffold to the model, (ii) replaces shape-based evaluation with seeded ground-truth scoring, and (iii) reports reliability beyond the mean through worst-case and tail-risk metrics. translated_title: 智能体基准测试中的双重测量混淆：去脚手架化、真值评分与超越均值的可靠性
translated_abstract: 智能体基准测试正被日益广泛地用于比较大语言模型（LLM）并指导部署决策，然而，只有当基准分数衡量的是模型能力而非评估流程本身的属性时，这些分数才具有意义。我们识别出一种双重测量混淆：执行关键决策由固定的脚手架（scaffold）而非模型来执行，同时评分器使用可能无法反映任务正确性的标准来评估输出。我们在测量理论的框架内统一了这些问题，该框架刻画了基准分数在何种情况下可以被解释为模型能力的证据，并通过一个审计与修复协议将其具体化，该协议：（i）将执行关键决策从脚手架转移给模型；（ii）用基于种子的真值评分取代基于形态的评估；（iii）通过最坏情况和尾部风险指标报告超越均值的可靠性。在 ComtradeBench 上的实验表明，联合……
tldr: 该论文识别出智能体基准测试中存在的“双重测量混淆”问题——固定脚手架代替模型执行关键决策且评分标准可能偏离任务正确性，并提出基于测量理论的审计与修复协议，通过去脚手架化、真值评分和尾部风险等超越均值的可靠性指标，使基准分数能更忠实地反映模型的真实能力。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies a "double measurement confound" in agent benchmarks—where a fixed scaffold performs execution-critical decisions and scorers may not reflect task correctness—and proposes a measurement-theoretic audit-and-repair protocol with de-scaffolding, seeded ground-truth scoring, and tail-risk reliability metrics beyond the mean to make benchmark scores faithful evidence of model capability.
